evidence.reason: The finding describes leasing the recovery push against the separate ls-remote result while only validating pr_info() against the journaled target. The current tip already implements the recommended fix: in recover_publication, when publication['open_pr'] is set, the expected lease value is publication['target'], and the push leases on that value with an ancestry check. The history's first entry (repair_tick-lease_recovery_push_on_journaled_target_for_open_PRs) is the fixing commit.
